$comment: audit-ci is the authoritative dependency-vulnerability gate for this repo.
The plain `npm audit` step in .github/workflows/security.yml is report-only,
because it has no way to record an accepted risk and so goes red forever.
Every entry below is an accepted risk with a stated reason and a fix path.
Do NOT add an advisory here without both. If an advisory becomes reachable in
production, remove it from this list and fix the dependency instead.
Anything not listed here fails the build — that is the point: the scan is
meant to catch NEW vulnerabilities, not to be permanently red.

$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff: vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths. Dev server only; production ships static files built by vite and never runs the dev server. Fix: vite@8 (major).
$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9: vite: path traversal in optimized-deps .map handling. Dev server only, same reasoning. Fix: vite@8 (major).
$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3: launch-editor (via vite): NTLMv2 hash disclosure over UNC paths on Windows. Dev-only tooling, Windows-specific. Fix: vite@8 (major).
$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99: esbuild: dev server accepts cross-origin requests. Dev server only. Fix: vite@8 (major), which pulls a patched esbuild.
$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6: react-router: open redirect via backslash in <Link>/useNavigate. Accepted for now: no route in this app builds a destination from untrusted input. Revisit if that changes. Fix: react-router-dom@7 (major).
$allowlist-rationale.GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg: react-router: arbitrary constructor injection in deserializeErrors() during SSR hydration. Not applicable — this is a client-rendered SPA with no SSR. Fix: react-router-dom@7 (major).
